# Distant hills (generated by make_env.py).
new
material new Hill --base-color 0.588 0.984 0.780 --no-slot
add mesh uv-sphere --name Hill0 --segments 10 --rings 6 --radius 1 --location -9 0 0
scale 5.5 3.3 1.1
apply --scale
material assign Hill
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.05"
delete face
mode object
add mesh uv-sphere --name Hill1 --segments 10 --rings 6 --radius 1 --location 1.5 2.5 0
scale 6.5 3.9 1.5
apply --scale
material assign Hill
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.05"
delete face
mode object
add mesh uv-sphere --name Hill2 --segments 10 --rings 6 --radius 1 --location 11 0.5 0
scale 5.0 3.0 0.9
apply --scale
material assign Hill
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.05"
delete face
mode object
add mesh uv-sphere --name Hill3 --segments 10 --rings 6 --radius 1 --location -17 2 0
scale 5 3.0 0.8
apply --scale
material assign Hill
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.05"
delete face
mode object
select all
shade flat
export hills.glb
